reserveReview.rationale: Issuer API source 2026-10-30T08:00:18.551Z reports $14,815,300.739121802 reserves and 14,522,836.657558644 USDO with a 102.0138% ratio. Positive constituents normalize to TBILL 93.75726776%, RLUSD 5.9810923%, and USDC 0.26163994%. BUIDL and VBILL are observed zero and create no positive holdings; USYC, BENJI, pending-USDC and uAmount are also zero. The ratio reconciles only reported usdoAmount, not every queued claim; pendingReserverAssetsRedeem and gap fields are unresolved context, not additional inventory. This is issuer accounting, not independent financial assurance or proof of redemption openness. Chainlink feed coverage measured 2026-10-19: Chainlink's Base feed directory lists the usdo-por feed (proxy 0x5218ebeb96bd2bafe21f9b143f5672552629ba79) with reserve asset U.S. Treasury Bills and porSource Wallet Address Manager. At Base block 52817725 its latestRoundData answer was 14,188,778.570757 (18 decimals), updated 2026-10-19T00:03:33Z. The issuer API snapshot dated 2026-10-19T08:00:18.584Z reported $15,556,010.22 reserves against 15,256,774.83 USDO; TBILL ($12,252,338.73), BUIDL ($1,499,432.10) and VBILL ($409,325.00) total $14,161,095.83, and the RLUSD and USDC buffer $1,394,914.39. The feed answer therefore sits below USDO supply and close to the Treasury-fund holdings alone, consistent with a feed that excludes the stablecoin buffer; it is not a full-basket reserve figure and should not be read as a reserve-to-supply ratio.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden states that USDO reserve assets and liabilities are held in a segregated account of a Bermuda segregated-accounts company and are insulated from claims against other accounts. The current reserve API identifies asset holdings but not the account-level custodians, provider shares, underlying fund custody chains, or rehypothecation terms. Rechecked 2026-10-20 against the current service-provider page and issuer-linked User Agreement dated 2026-10-14: contractual segregated-account recourse is not ownership of reserve assets, and named service providers do not establish the complete allocated custody chain. The former whole-asset institutional-regulated custodyModel scalar is therefore withdrawn to unknown; BMA issuance supervision and the existing segregated-account facts are retained. Original custody review start is not renewed.
